 Dengue fever cases soar in Florida as mosquito-borne illness spreads
 06:03 Dengue fever cases soar in Florida as mosquito-borne illness spreads
 Dengue fever cases are on the rise across Florida, and a potential Super El Niño could help create conditions that allow mosquitoes to remain active longer. FOX News Medical Contributor Dr. Jessica Gray joins FOX Weather to discuss the growing concern and what it could mean for the Sunshine State.
